project.next-gen-command:
# number of steps per WU nsteps_per_WU=2500000
# Generate a new mdp file using the old mdp. Increasing the start-time and adding the continuation key-word. random=\$(echo " " |/usr/bin/awk '{print rand()*1000000}') starttime=\$(((\$nsteps_per_WU*$gen)))
/home/server/anaconda3/bin/python /home/server/server2/projects/Gromacs/p15511/make_continuation_mdp.py $home/RUN$run/prod.mdp \$starttime 300 > $jobdir/prod_\$random.mdp
# Generate the next gen tpr based on the new mdp file and the previous gen velocities and positions /usr/local/gromacs-2020/bin/gmx grompp -t $results/state.cpt -c $results/frame$prev-gen.gro -f $jobdir/prod_\$random.mdp -n $home/RUN$run/index.ndx -p $home/RUN$run/topol.top -o $jobdir/frame$gen.tpr
# Remove unnecessary mdp. # /bin/rm -f $jobdir/prod_\$random.mdp
# Save previous-gen gro file and cpt. /bin/mv $results/frame$prev-gen.gro $jobdir /bin/mv $results/state.cpt $jobdir/frame$prev-gen.cpt
